name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Press to March
description: Clean or hold a single bell in the rack, press it to a locked-out overhead position, then march in place — lifting alternate knees — while keeping the bell stacked overhead. The overhead load turns the march into an anti-lateral-flexion core challenge: the obliques fight to keep the torso stacked under the offset weight as each knee lifts. Press with the shoulder packed DOWN (not shrugged up), ribs down, elbow locked, and brace hard through every march step so the bell stays over the shoulder, not drifting forward or out. Complete the reps on one side, then switch.
